summary: Streaming digital humans produce detailed video while continuing speech as new text arrives. High-resolution denoising is costly, and text updates can cause repeated or interrupted speech.
takeaways: We present TaoMate-HD, an autoregressive model for high-resolution audio-video streaming.
Across text updates, the model retains this history to infer what has already been spoken.
Experiments show a 1.6x speedup over direct high-resolution generation with the same model and hardware.
